deadline.value: Apply by January 15 for financial support; applications through March 1 are considered if early offers are declined.

gre_general.value: The GRE General test is required.
gre_general.quote: The GRE score (general test) is required.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: About 15 to 20 students are admitted each year and around seven start as teaching assistants.
funding.quote: About 15 to 20 students are typically accepted into the program, and of these around seven begin with a teaching assistantship

entry_route.value: The page does not say whether a bachelor's alone is enough for the PhD.

english_waiver.value: India is not an English-official country, so Indian applicants must take a language test.
english_waiver.quote: For applicants from countries where English is not an official language, you should take a language proficiency exam
